branch_policy:
  default_branch: main
  separate_branch_allowed: true
  single_allowed_branch: codex/example-single-branch
  stage_specific_branches_forbidden: true

expected_primary_touches:
- docs/architecture/example/example-stage-ledger.md

Ledger: update stage ledger.
File manifest: created/modified/deleted.

Use the already approved single prompt-pack branch only; no per-stage branches.
